title: Revisiting The PBH Test: Fast Uncontrollability Certificates via Krylov Methods
summary: This letter revisits the classical PBH test through the lens of finite-horizon reachability. By casting state transfer as a minimum energy, primal optimization problem, we show that unreachable state-space maneuvers admit dual infeasibility certificates. These certificates are computable without forming the controllability matrix meaning that uncontrollability can be efficiently certified. We prove that any such certificate is a linear combination of uncontrollable generalized eigenvectors, thereby providing a spectral interpretation without a global eigendecomposition.
